Competence includes interpretation and purposeful creation while acknowledging selection, measurement, projection and source limitations.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como mapas, globos e dados espaciais representam os elementos da Terra e suas relações.

#### Coordenadas geográficas

Skills: 3

[geographicCoordinates.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/geographicCoordinates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The graticule provides a worldwide angular reference for positions. Latitude and longitude are distinct measurements whose ordered combination identifies a location.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use latitude e longitude para descrever locais na Terra.

##### Interpretar latitude

[interpretLatitude.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/interpretLatitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the Equator as zero latitude and compare how far a point lies toward either pole.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Leia a latitude como uma posição ao norte ou ao sul da Linha do Equador.

##### Interpretar longitude

[interpretLongitude.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/interpretLongitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the reference meridian and longitude values to locate east–west positions without confusing them with latitude.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Leia a longitude como uma posição a leste ou oeste de um meridiano de referência.

##### Localizar um ponto com um par latitude-longitude

[locateAPointFromALatitudeLongitudePair.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/locateAPointFromALatitudeLongitudePair.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use both coordinates in their proper order and hemispheres to identify a geographic position.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Encontre um lugar com latitude e longitude informadas na ordem correta.

#### Tecnologias geoespaciais

Skills: 3

[geospatialTechnologies.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/geospatialTechnologies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Satellite and aerial imagery, positioning systems and geographic information systems provide different kinds of geographically referenced evidence. The focus is interpreting and using that evidence for geographic questions, not programming a software package or memorizing individual interface controls.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como imagens de satélite, sistemas de posicionamento e camadas espaciais oferecem evidências.

##### Analisar relações geográficas com camadas de dados espaciais

[analyzeGeographicRelationshipsUsingSpatialDataLayers.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/analyzeGeographicRelationshipsUsingSpatialDataLayers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine separately mapped geographic properties to investigate co-occurrence, proximity or spatial variation, taking account of registration, resolution and the risk of mistaking correlation for causation. GIS is a possible tool rather than the definition of the Skill.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Combine camadas espaciais para estudar padrões sem presumir que correlação comprova causalidade.

##### Interpretar imagens de sensoriamento remoto

[interpretRemoteSensingImagery.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/interpretRemoteSensingImagery.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use spatial patterns, scale, source limitations and visible characteristics in aerial or satellite observations to infer geographic features and land-cover change. Comparing two dated images is one application of this competence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Interprete imagens aéreas ou de satélite para investigar elementos geográficos e mudanças.

##### Usar dados de posicionamento por satélite para orientação

[useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position supplied by a GNSS device in relation to a coordinate reference and the surrounding geography; recognize that positioning has uncertainty and does not directly describe what is at the location.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use uma localização por satélite reconhecendo sua possível imprecisão.

#### Globos, mapas e projeções

Skills: 3

[globesMapsAndProjection.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/globesMapsAndProjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A spherical Earth cannot be shown on a flat sheet without some distortion, and different representations support different questions. Choosing one is a reasoning decision rather than a display preference.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como mapas e globos representam a superfície curva da Terra de formas diferentes.

##### Distinguir globo e mapa plano como modelos da Terra

[distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a globe represents the overall shape of Earth more directly while a flat map is easier to use for selected areas or purposes.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique o que um globo representa mais diretamente do que um mapa plano.

##### Reconhecer distorções de área ou forma nas projeções

[recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that apparent sizes and shapes can change when the curved surface is flattened, especially when comparing distant latitudes.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça como achatar a Terra altera tamanhos ou formas aparentes.

##### Selecionar uma representação geográfica para uma finalidade

[selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose a globe, world or regional map, or detailed street plan according to the required spatial extent, scale and projection properties. This concerns the _representation and coverage_; choosing the subject matter of a political, geological or population map is a separate Skill.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Escolha entre um globo, um mapa de área ampla e uma planta detalhada conforme o objetivo.

#### Desenho e convenções cartográficas

Skills: 4

[mapDesignAndConventions.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/mapDesignAndConventions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Creating and interpreting maps requires deliberate choices of symbols, legends, orientation, scale and labels. Conventions allow readers to infer geographic meaning from an authored representation without treating a map as a literal replica of the ground.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda como símbolos, legendas, escala e orientação tornam um mapa compreensível.

##### Criar mapas

[createMaps.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/createMaps.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select an appropriate spatial extent and represent places or geographically referenced information with consistent symbols, orientation, labels and scale as needed for a communication purpose. Sketching a classroom plan and constructing a thematic map are applications, not automatically distinct Skills.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Crie um mapa claro com símbolos, rótulos, orientação e escala adequados.

##### Determinar a orientação de um mapa pelo indicador do norte

[determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the map's stated orientation rather than assuming the top of every depiction is geographic north.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Oriente um mapa pelo indicador do norte sem supor que o norte está sempre em cima.

##### Interpretar a escala do mapa como relação entre distâncias

[interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a short mark on paper or screen represents a larger distance on the ground and that the ratio changes with scale.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Interprete a relação entre distâncias no mapa e distâncias reais no terreno.

##### Interpretar símbolos cartográficos pela legenda

[interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a symbol or color to its documented meaning instead of assuming that its appearance is self-explanatory.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use a legenda para descobrir o significado dos símbolos e das cores.

#### Tipos de mapas e camadas temáticas

Skills: 3

[mapTypesAndThematicLayers.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/mapTypesAndThematicLayers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maps may emphasize general reference features, political territories, physical relief, topography or specific themes such as geology, population, climate, weather, transport and resources. Categories overlap: for example, a geological or population map is thematic, and many maps combine layers. Choosing the relevant content is distinct from choosing a globe or map scale.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como diferentes mapas mostram limites, relevo, tempo, população e muito mais.

##### Identificar tipos comuns de mapas pelo conteúdo

[identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize whether a map presents political boundaries, physical relief, topographic detail, geological units, climate, population, resources or transport, using its title, legend and depicted variables. Explain that reference and thematic are broad roles, not mutually exclusive lists of named maps.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Identifique o tipo de informação geográfica representada no mapa.

##### Interpretar uma legenda temática e suas classes de valores

[interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate mapped color ranges, symbol sizes, or categories to the underlying variable while respecting units and class boundaries.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use legendas temáticas para ler categorias, faixas e valores do mapa.

##### Escolher um tipo de mapa para uma questão geográfica

[selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match a question to the type of information a map must show: for example, use a geological map to investigate rock distribution or a population-density map to compare settlement concentration. Do not substitute a visually attractive map lacking the required variable.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Escolha o tipo de mapa adequado para uma questão geográfica específica.

### Regiões naturais e biogeografia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[naturalRegionsAndBiogeography.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions create geographic variation in ecosystems, biodiversity and habitat patterns on land and in water. This field describes where ecological regions occur, how their distributions vary and how landscape changes affect them; organism physiology and detailed food-web mechanisms belong primarily to Biology.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como o clima, o relevo e a água influenciam a distribuição geográfica dos seres vivos.

#### Biomas e habitats

Skills: 3

[biomesAndHabitats.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/biomesAndHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Broad vegetation and habitat patterns reflect environmental conditions while local ecosystems can be more varied than a single biome label suggests.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra por que grandes tipos de habitat ocorrem em diferentes partes do mundo.

##### Comparar condições de habitat entre localidades geográficas

[compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use temperature, moisture, altitude, and land cover to explain contrasts in living conditions for organisms.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare as condições que formam habitats diferentes em lugares distintos.

##### Identificar padrões dos principais biomas terrestres

[identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate broad forest, grassland, desert, and tundra patterns with environmental conditions rather than treating them as isolated species lists.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça os padrões globais de distribuição de florestas, campos, desertos e tundras.

##### Reconhecer zonas de transição entre biomas

[recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that vegetation and environmental conditions may change gradually across boundaries rather than at a perfectly sharp line.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda por que os limites entre biomas podem mudar gradualmente, em vez de abruptamente.

#### Ecossistemas

Skills: 4

[ecosystems.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/ecosystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ecosystems develop under different physical conditions on land and in water, and can vary markedly in spatial extent and connectivity. Geography focuses on the distributions of terrestrial, marine and freshwater environments, their boundaries, fragmentation and regional relationships, rather than organism physiology.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore onde ocorrem diferentes ecossistemas e como eles se conectam nas paisagens.

##### Distinguir ecossistemas marinhos e de água doce

[distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate aquatic ecosystems shaped by saline ocean or sea water from those associated with predominantly fresh rivers, lakes and wetlands. Use salinity, water movement and geographic connections to explain broad habitat differences; recognize estuaries and other brackish transitional environments instead of forcing every location into one of two categories.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Distinga ambientes marinhos, de água doce e de transição com água salobra.

##### Explicar a fragmentação de habitats como processo geográfico

[explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate roads, land-cover change or other barriers to the separation of formerly connected habitat areas, recognizing that the ecological consequences depend on species and landscape context.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique como estradas ou mudanças no uso da terra podem separar habitats antes conectados.

##### Interpretar a conectividade entre habitats naturais

[interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether geographic corridors or barriers link habitat patches and enable movement across a landscape, without claiming that proximity automatically guarantees ecological connection.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Identifique corredores naturais e barreiras entre fragmentos de habitat.

##### Interpretar padrões geográficos de biodiversidade

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify broad differences in variety of living organisms across mapped regions and relate them cautiously to climate, habitat complexity, disturbance and observation coverage.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use mapas para comparar a biodiversidade entre regiões, considerando diferenças nas observações.

#### Gradientes ambientais

Skills: 3

[environmentalGradients.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/environmentalGradients.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions often vary systematically with elevation, latitude, and proximity to water. Such gradients help explain patterns without implying that every place at the same latitude is identical.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como a natureza varia conforme a latitude, a altitude e a proximidade da água.

##### Explicar variações ambientais amplas conforme a latitude

[explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect differences in solar input and circulation to large-scale environmental belts while allowing local exceptions.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Relacione a latitude às grandes diferenças de luz solar e condições naturais.

##### Identificar mudanças ambientais por evidências geográficas comparadas

[identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use two dated distributions or observations to describe a change in habitat range, without automatically assigning a single cause.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use mapas ou observações de datas diferentes para perceber mudanças nos habitats.

##### Reconhecer mudanças das condições naturais com a altitude

[recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how cooler temperatures and vegetation zones can occur higher on mountains without assuming identical patterns everywhere.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça como habitats e temperaturas mudam ao subir as encostas de montanhas.

### Orientação espacial

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

[spatialOrientation.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locating and orienting oneself requires a stable or relative reference, directions, remembered spatial relationships and awareness of changing spatial and temporal frames. These competencies concern where places are, how we navigate between them, and how their civil and solar times relate—not how maps are drawn.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como lugares, direções, trajetos e diferenças de horário nos ajudam a nos orientar.

#### Localização e referências

Skills: 3

[locationAndReference.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/locationAndReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locations can be described relative to a chosen reference, identified using stable geographic or civic references, and situated within areas of different spatial extent. The identity of the reference must be explicit rather than assumed from the observer.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda a descrever lugares usando pontos de referência claros.

##### Descrever uma localização em relação a um ponto de referência

[describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Express where a place lies by referring to another identifiable object or location, such as 'east of the station' or 'next to the bridge'. The statement changes meaning when its reference point changes.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descreva onde algo está em relação a outro lugar identificável.

##### Identificar um local por uma referência absoluta

[identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a stable agreed identifier, such as a coordinate pair in a named system or an address within a specified jurisdiction, to locate a place independently of a movable observer. Interpreting latitude and longitude is a separate cartographic competency.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Localize um lugar usando uma referência estável, como endereço ou coordenadas.

##### Identificar locais nas escalas local, regional e global

[identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the same place to nested areas such as a neighborhood, country, and world region without confusing a change of scale with physical movement.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Identifique o mesmo lugar nas escalas do bairro, da região e do mundo.

#### Navegação e mapas mentais

Skills: 4

[navigationAndMentalMaps.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/navigationAndMentalMaps.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving between places relies on orientation, directional instructions, and sequences of turns. The focus is spatial navigation, not the mathematical calculation of distance.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda a se orientar usando direções, pontos de referência e relações espaciais lembradas.

##### Traçar uma rota por pontos de passagem ordenados

[constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose an intelligible sequence of landmarks and turns between two positions, checking that the instructions preserve connectivity.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Planeje rotas contínuas usando pontos de referência e curvas na ordem correta.

##### Usar os pontos cardeais para orientar uma rota

[useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate north, east, south, and west with actual movement or a stated orientation, even when the observer faces a different way.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use norte, sul, leste e oeste ao seguir uma rota.

##### Usar direções intermediárias para distinguir rumos

[useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate positions such as northeast between adjacent cardinal directions rather than treating the compass as only four separate choices.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça na bússola direções como nordeste e sudoeste.

##### Usar mapas mentais para orientação espacial

[useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent remembered places and spatial relationships internally, and use that representation to reason about position or a route without consulting a physical map. Drawing a familiar route, revising it after a new observation and imagining landmarks are different exercises for the same transferable spatial ability.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use sua memória dos lugares para entender onde está e como chegar a outro local.

#### Relações espaciais

Skills: 3

[spatialRelationships.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/spatialRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Places and features form patterns of nearness, containment, connection, concentration, and separation. These relationships matter even when the exact names of the locations change.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça como lugares podem estar conectados, separados ou distribuídos em padrões.

##### Descrever distribuições agrupadas e dispersas

[describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare objects gathered in a small area with objects spread across a larger one while considering the observation scale.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descreva se os elementos estão agrupados ou espalhados.

##### Distinguir adjacência de proximidade

[distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Two territories may share a boundary without being close to the same external landmark; nearby places need not touch.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Diferencie lugares que se encostam daqueles que apenas ficam próximos.

##### Identificar barreiras e corredores entre lugares

[identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a mountain range, river crossing, valley, or road can restrict or enable movement between otherwise nearby locations.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique como montanhas, vales, estradas e travessias afetam as viagens entre lugares.

#### Fusos horários

Skills: 6

[timeZones.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/timeZones.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth's rotation gives different longitudes different solar timing, while societies coordinate clocks through geographically assigned civil time rules. The same place can be described by its solar time, legal time-zone assignment, UTC offset and calendar date; these are related but not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como a rotação da Terra e as regras locais determinam as horas indicadas nos relógios.

##### Determinar a hora civil a partir de um deslocamento UTC

[determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply a stated positive or negative offset to a known UTC time for a particular date, including when the resulting local date moves to the previous or next day. Do not infer an offset from longitude alone.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Calcule a hora local com base no UTC e no deslocamento informado, incluindo mudanças de data.

##### Explicar mudanças sazonais na hora oficial

[explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that some jurisdictions change their legal UTC offsets seasonally while others do not, and that the applicable rule depends on place and date rather than a universal daylight-saving schedule.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda por que alguns lugares mudam a hora conforme a estação e outros não.

##### Explicar o conceito de hora civil local

[explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that the legally observed clock time in a place depends on the jurisdiction and applicable time zone, and can differ from the Sun's position. Civil local time is not the same concept as local solar time, and different places can share one civil clock time.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Diferencie a hora legal de um lugar do tempo baseado no Sol.

##### Explicar por que a hora solar local varia com a longitude

[explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect Earth's rotation with the apparent passage of the Sun across the sky: places at different longitudes reach solar noon at different moments. This geographic tendency is not a rule that political zone boundaries follow exact meridians.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique por que o meio-dia solar ocorre em momentos diferentes em longitudes distintas.

##### Interpretar mudanças de data ao cruzar a Linha Internacional de Data

[interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine why adjacent locations on opposite sides of the approximate Pacific date boundary can have different calendar dates, noting that its actual course follows regional civil-time choices rather than a perfectly straight meridian.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique por que cruzar a Linha Internacional de Data pode mudar a data do calendário.

##### Interpretar os fusos horários em um mapa

[interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate places assigned to different civil time zones using a legend or UTC offsets; recognize that boundaries may follow political borders and that some regions use half-hour or quarter-hour offsets.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Leia em um mapa os limites dos fusos horários e os deslocamentos UTC.

### Sistemas hídricos

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[waterSystems.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/waterSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water connects landscapes through drainage networks, oceans, atmosphere, and underground storage. Geographic questions center on where water moves and accumulates, how its distribution varies, and how water features shape places.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore onde a água da Terra fica armazenada, como circula e molda os lugares.

#### Água congelada e subterrânea

Skills: 4

[frozenAndSubsurfaceWater.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Snow, ice and groundwater store freshwater for different durations and interact with landscapes and human supplies. Their accumulation and discharge vary with climate, geology and geography rather than being visible only in rivers.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como neve, gelo e águas subterrâneas armazenam água doce.

##### Explicar a formação e o movimento das geleiras

[explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sustained snow accumulation and compaction to slowly flowing land ice, distinguishing glaciers from seasonal snow cover and floating sea ice.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique como a neve acumulada vira uma geleira que se move lentamente.

##### Explicar como geleiras modificam o relevo

[explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize broad erosional and depositional outcomes of moving land ice, such as glacial valleys, moraines and transported sediment, without treating all U-shaped valleys as proof of one event.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça formas do terreno escavadas ou deixadas por geleiras.

##### Explicar o conceito de aquífero

[explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a permeable geological layer or formation that can store and transmit useful groundwater, distinguishing an aquifer from an open underground lake.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda como rochas permeáveis armazenam e conduzem água subterrânea.

##### Interpretar variações regionais no armazenamento de água doce

[interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare places in which ice, aquifers, lakes or rivers hold accessible freshwater, recognizing differences in replenishment, seasonal availability and extraction limits.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare gelo, aquíferos, lagos e rios como reservatórios em diferentes regiões.

#### Conexões hidrológicas

Skills: 4

[hydrologicConnections.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/hydrologicConnections.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water changes location and state among the atmosphere, surface, living systems, and subsurface. This is a connected circulation model rather than a single linear loop.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Veja como a água circula entre ar, terra, organismos e reservas subterrâneas.

##### Comparar a disponibilidade de água entre regiões

[compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate precipitation, storage, seasonal variation, and demand to differences in accessible fresh water, rather than equating wet weather with secure supply.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare a água doce disponível em diferentes regiões.

##### Explicar infiltração e recarga de aquíferos

[explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect water entering permeable soils and rock to subsurface flow and replenishment of groundwater storage, distinguishing a downward pathway from direct surface runoff.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique como a água penetra no solo e nas rochas e repõe a água subterrânea.

##### Explicar o escoamento superficial

[explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe water moving across land toward lower terrain and drainage networks when rainfall or melt exceeds infiltration and storage, distinguishing the process from water already stored underground.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descreva como o excesso de chuva ou degelo flui pela superfície.

##### Explicar o ciclo da água

[explainTheHydrologicCycle.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainTheHydrologicCycle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the movement and storage of water among atmosphere, surface, living systems, ice and subsurface through evaporation, condensation, precipitation and flow. The cycles are multiple interconnected paths, not one mandatory linear sequence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique a ligação entre evaporação, precipitação, armazenamento e escoamento.

#### Processos marinhos e costeiros

Skills: 3

[marineAndCoastalProcesses.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/marineAndCoastalProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coastal and marine environments differ in exposure, enclosure, water movement, and relation to land. The emphasis is on geographic patterns and coastal form rather than detailed fluid dynamics.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como ondas, marés e correntes afetam os oceanos e o litoral.

##### Identificar feições de erosão e deposição costeira

[identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate cliffs, beaches, spits, or deltas to material removal and accumulation in their coastal setting.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça formas costeiras criadas pela erosão e pelo acúmulo de sedimentos.

##### Interpretar padrões geográficos das correntes oceânicas

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize major surface-current directions and geographic effects on coastal climate, transport and marine conditions, without confusing circulation with periodic tidal change.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Interprete o padrão das correntes e seus efeitos nas regiões litorâneas.

##### Interpretar padrões geográficos das marés

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify regional and temporal variations in tidal water levels and their implications for coastlines and navigation, distinguishing tidal cycles from persistent ocean currents.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare como as marés variam conforme o lugar e o horário no litoral.

#### Rios e bacias hidrográficas

Skills: 2

[riversAndDrainageBasins.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/riversAndDrainageBasins.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Flowing water links sources, tributaries and outlets into networks, while topography governs the surface catchment of a river. Describing different types of water bodies as objects belongs to Geographic Objects.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como riachos e rios formam redes de drenagem.

##### Delimitar uma bacia pelo relevo

[delineateADrainageBasinFromTerrain.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/skills/delineateADrainageBasinFromTerrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer the land area contributing runoff to an outlet using divides and slopes rather than administrative borders.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Identifique a área cujo escoamento chega a uma saída fluvial específica.

##### Identificar partes de uma rede fluvial

[identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.data.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/skills/identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish source, tributary, confluence, channel, and mouth by their roles in connected flow.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça nascente, afluentes, confluências, leito e foz de um rio.
